messages:
Elaine H: quick thought — can we make routing pick the lowest expected tail-latency region *after* applying a per-customer jitter/bias? e.g. enterprise customers prefer local region unless latency diff > X.
Mohit K: yes — we discussed something like a "preferred_region_score" before but never combined it with a latency delta threshold. do you mean we should compute: score = latency_ms + tier_penalty + egress_cost_penalty?
Elaine H: exactly. then if the best-scoring region can't satisfy SLOs we fallback to a model variant (smaller quantized) in a closer region to avoid timeouts. keeps user experience consistent.
Sara L: love it. question: how would this look in the public routing config / API? we should avoid leaking too many knobs to customers but expose a simple "latency_safety_margin_ms" and "variant_fallback_policy" in console.
Jorge P: prototype config snippet I sketched for internal API:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  region_preferences:
    - region: us-west1
      bias_ms: 0
    - region: us-east1
      bias_ms: 20
    - region: europe-west1
      bias_ms: 40
  latency_threshold_ms: 100   # only switch region if delta > threshold
  tier_bias:
    free: 100
    standard: 30
    enterprise: 0
  egress_cost_weight: 0.8
  fallback_variants:
    - model: redwood-medium-q4
      weight: 0.6
    - model: redwood-small-q4
      weight: 0.4
```
Tanya R: one caveat — telemetry needs to capture the pre-bias and post-bias decisions so we can debug why a customer was steered away. metrics: chosen_region, raw_latency_ms, adjusted_score, fallback_model_id. also surface a small timeline in console for each request (sampled).
Mohit K: agree. we should also record "why" (reason codes): e.g. REASON_LATENCY_DELTA, REASON_CAPACITY_EVICT, REASON_QUOTA_EXCEEDED, REASON_COST_THRESHOLD. that will help rollout analysis.
Sara L: UX: add a per-customer toggle in the Console (rollout) to opt into aggressive-cost-saving mode (bias to cheaper region + higher fallback probability). show expected p95 change and cost delta before flip.
Elaine H: Ops-bot kicked off a quick simulation run for stages: dev -> canary -> prod (small sample).
ops-bot: simulation started: id=sim-20260320-11, config=weighted-latency-variant-steer, sample=5% of traffic in canary, duration=2h :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Jorge P: I'll wire the telemetry events and add the adjusted_score field to trace headers. ETA for PR: EOD tomorrow.
Tanya R: I'll mock Console panels (per-route preview + rollback button + reason-code drilldown). sending screenshots in #design after lunch.
Elaine H: next steps: (1) small API change to accept bias_ms and fallback_variants (Mohit/Jorge), (2) telemetry + reason codes (Jorge/Tanya), (3) Console opt & preview (Sara/Tanya), (4) run ops-bot sim and analyze p95/cost (Elaine/Mohit). thanks all :thumbsup:
